name: Rosewood Matakauri Lodge
insider_take: Perched dramatically on the shores of Lake Wakatipu with panorizing views of The Remarkables mountain range, this ultra-luxury lodge offers an intimate alpine sanctuary where every suite feels like a private retreat.
whats_special: This is New Zealand's first Rosewood property, featuring just 11 suites and villa accommodations scattered across 40 acres of pristine lakefront. The lodge sits on a deer farm dating back to the 1860s, and its architecture seamlessly blends contemporary luxury with the rugged Southern Alps landscape. Each suite boasts floor-to-ceiling windows framing unobstructed lake and mountain vistas.
pro_tip: Book the Owners' Cottage for ultimate privacy - it comes with a dedicated Range Rover and driver, plus exclusive access to hidden hiking trails on the property that most guests never discover.
dont_miss: The helicopter pad allows for exclusive scenic flights over Milford Sound and glacier landings. The lodge's private beach offers lake activities like kayaking and fishing, while the on-site spa features treatments using indigenous Manuka honey and thermal mineral therapies. Their farm-to-table restaurant sources ingredients from the property's own kitchen garden and local Central Otago vineyards.
pros: Spectacular lakefront location with panoramic views of Lake Wakatipu and The Remarkables mountain range
Ultra-luxurious all-suite accommodations with private outdoor spaces and fireplaces
World-class spa and wellness facilities with indigenous New Zealand treatments
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio and bespoke experiences
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting ultra-high-end positioning
Remote location requires transfer from Queenstown city center
